props.name: Asmita Patel
props.alias: The She-Wolf of the stock market
props.charge: Ran paid "courses" that were really unregistered buy/sell advisory — of ~Rs 104 cr earned, SEBI impounded Rs 53.67 cr and barred her and 5 entities.
props.lesson: "Options queen" branding is marketing. A SEBI order is a fact.

props.title: Seven red flags in a viral profit claim

items.d: A real advisor shows an RIA registration; a finfluencer shows a Lambo.
Cropped P&L pop-ups are trivially faked; audited broker statements aren't.
You see the one win, never the ten blown accounts behind it.
No one can guarantee a market return. The word itself is the tell.
The money is made selling you the dream, not trading it.
"1 lakh to 44 lakh" once proves luck, not skill.

lines: It still hasn't reclaimed its peak.
props.sub: SEBI: ~9 in 10 individual F&O traders lose money.

props.title: What actually made money
items: The winners held quality businesses for years, not days
Some concentrated (Damani), some diversified (Kacholia) — all patient
They bought weakness — the April crash was an opportunity
No leverage-gambling, no tips, no "sure-shot" anything
The boring SIP investor quietly beat most "experts"
Every viral 44x claim you can't verify — assume it's marketing
Real edge is temperament, not a secret indicator
props.closer: Wealth was built by patience — and protected by skepticism.
